pages.text: Jua Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Kilele Asset Managers (SYN). Jua Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to generate regular income from government and corporate bonds. The management fee of Jua Bond Fund is 1.6 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Jua Bond Fund is SYN Sh 10,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 100. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Jua Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 9.7 percent.

Withdrawals from Jua Bond Fund are paid within 2 business days. The main holdings of Jua Bond Fund are Treasury bonds (35 percent), infrastructure bonds (25 percent) and bank bonds (10 percent). Pwani Trustees (SYN) acts as trustee of Jua Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Jua Bond Fund was launched in 2013 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
